windows_package.evidence: FrameLink Windows x64 portable package built, verified runtime smoke test, and packaged as FrameLink-Windows-x64.zip.

linux_package.evidence: FrameLink Linux x86_64 portable tarball and AppImage built and verified on Linux (Arch / Ubuntu compatible).

windows_capture.evidence: Windows Server CI exercises capture but does not verify Windows 10/11 client hardware; current iPhone reliability patch awaits exact-commit CI.

linux_x11_capture.evidence: Current MP4 source captured native Qt X11 under Xvfb: H.264 MP4 1280x720, 152 decoded frames over 5.067 seconds, 30.00 actual FPS, Completed without recorder error. FFprobe confirms MP4; output folder has no JPG or MKV. Evidence: artifacts/mp4-native-x11/. Physical X11 hardware unverified.

linux_wayland_capture.evidence: Arch Linux / Hyprland PipeWire and xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast capture verified.

android_chrome.evidence: Physical Android Chrome camera, trust and reconnect testing remains unavailable; synthetic Chromium is not device verification.

ios_safari.evidence: User reports real Safari connected-without-video and camera shutdown. Confirmed lifecycle fixes pass local tests, but initial video-loss cause and physical Safari retest remain unverified. See docs/IPHONE_RELIABILITY.md.

offline_hotspot.evidence: Private LAN and synthetic candidate tests do not establish real offline iPhone/desktop hotspot operation; physical routing/isolation checks remain pending.

audio_sync.evidence: Decoded synthetic audio/video checks pass, but physical phone/computer long-duration synchronization and Windows audio hardware remain unverified.

dependency_license_audit.evidence: docs/DISTRIBUTION_AUDIT.md records an incomplete corresponding-source/native-dependency distribution audit; no completed evidence supersedes that report.

recording_stop.evidence: Actual Qt Stop clicks in Screen, Phone, Both PiP and Both separate; two consecutive sessions per mode and duplicate Stop; tests/test_recording_stop.py.

recording_finalization.evidence: Full media decoding, duration checks, atomic promotion and indexing precede Completed. Initialization cancellation, source loss and encoder failure retain originals; tests/test_recording_stop.py.

compression_after_stop.evidence: Automatic compression jobs finished after actual Qt Stop in every recording mode across repeated sessions; tests/test_recording_stop.py.

camera_quality.evidence: Same moving 1080p browser fixture before/after; received and saved resolution increased from 640x360 to 1920x1080. Local regression gate requires at least 24 received and decoded FPS. Evidence: docs/verification/critical-fixes/camera-comparison.json. Physical cameras unverified.

preview_fill.evidence: Center-crop geometry and real Qt painting pass portrait, landscape, resize and source-DPR tests. Actual Studio screenshots with labelled fixtures: docs/verification/critical-fixes/.

tls_endpoint.evidence: Strict TLSv1.3 validation of actual listener at current LAN QR IP passed chain, signature, SAN, EKU and validity. Cached key/signature mismatch and stale-listener regressions covered. This does not attest iPhone trust.

critical_regressions.evidence: 167 local tests passed in the iPhone lifecycle investigation; follow-up targeted tests, Node watchdog/startup/remote controls, Ruff and TLS-validated synthetic WebRTC/Qt/MP4 integration passed. Physical Safari reliability remains unverified. See docs/IPHONE_RELIABILITY.md.
